[EN] Mission Orders

Eliminate the enemies in the Gallery of Chaos and the Gallery of Fate in Azarel's Labyrinth and bring proof of their deaths.

Operation Target: {@LinkCreature:9#810#gula gourmands}, {@LinkCreature:9#910#caiman zealots}, {@LinkCreature:9#440#gula eviscerators}, {@LinkCreature:9#450#gula ragers}, {@LinkCreature:9#1000#Lokian bloodreapers}, {@LinkCreature:9#1100#Lokian bowmasters}, {@LinkCreature:9#1200#Lokian champions}, and {@LinkCreature:9#1300#Lokian bloodragers}.

Elimina a los enemigos en la Gallery of Chaos y la Gallery of Fate de Azarel's Labyrinth y trae pruebas de su muerte.

Objetivo de la operación: {@LinkCreature:9#810#gula gourmands}, {@LinkCreature:9#910#caiman zealots}, {@LinkCreature:9#440#gula eviscerators}, {@LinkCreature:9#450#gula ragers}, {@LinkCreature:9#1000#Lokian bloodreapers}, {@LinkCreature:9#1100#Lokian bowmasters}, {@LinkCreature:9#1200#Lokian champions} y {@LinkCreature:9#1300#Lokian bloodragers}.
